paths.title: Backup and Disaster Recovery Specialist
entry_prerequisites: Infrastructure fundamentals plus awareness of business continuity, identity, networking and data dependencies

milestones.rationale: Establish recovery objectives, dependency scope, integrity and immutability before recovery operations.
Connect DR orchestration with read-only recoverability evidence and bounded troubleshooting.
Validate scenario judgement around RPO/RTO, ransomware resilience, restore assurance and failback.
Integrate protection, restore evidence, dependency recovery and controlled DR governance into one enterprise assurance exercise.

paths.dependency_notes: Recovery objectives and protection integrity precede orchestration; restore/failover judgement is validated before integrated recoverability assurance.
paths.status_rationale: The physical corpus covers RPO/RTO, protection integrity, immutability, DR orchestration, read-only recovery evidence, troubleshooting, assessment, interview judgement and an integrated recoverability capstone.

paths.title: VMware vSphere Infrastructure Specialist
paths.target_role: VMware Engineer / Virtualization Engineer / Infrastructure Architect
entry_prerequisites: Server, networking and storage fundamentals plus enterprise change-control awareness

milestones.rationale: Establish vSphere architecture and distinguish HA, DRS and vMotion operating boundaries.
Build lifecycle assurance, read-only cluster evidence and evidence-first failure diagnosis.
Validate senior cluster, mobility and lifecycle judgement.
Integrate resilience, mobility dependencies, lifecycle readiness and change safety in one production assurance exercise.

paths.dependency_notes: Architecture and cluster-service semantics precede lifecycle operations; evidence and troubleshooting precede any maintenance or remediation decision.
paths.status_rationale: The physical corpus covers vCenter/ESXi architecture, HA/DRS/vMotion, lifecycle management, read-only evidence, troubleshooting, assessment, interview judgement and an integrated vSphere assurance capstone.

paths.title: Cloud FinOps Engineering Specialist
paths.target_role: FinOps Practitioner / Cloud Engineer / Cloud Architect
entry_prerequisites: Azure/AWS fundamentals and basic understanding of cloud consumption, ownership and financial accountability

milestones.rationale: Establish FinOps operating principles, allocation and evidence-based anomaly response.
Connect optimization and unit economics with read-only cost evidence and disciplined variance diagnosis.
Validate senior allocation, commitment, optimization and business-value judgement.
Integrate accountability, variance analysis, optimization and unit economics into one multi-cloud decision exercise.

paths.dependency_notes: Allocation and anomaly literacy precede optimization; commitment and business-value decisions follow only after evidence and architecture constraints are understood.
paths.status_rationale: The physical corpus covers allocation, budgets/forecasting, anomaly response, usage/rate optimization, unit economics, read-only evidence, troubleshooting, assessment, interview judgement and an integrated FinOps capstone.

paths.title: Infrastructure Architecture and SRE Specialist
paths.target_role: Infrastructure Architect / SRE / Principal Engineer / Technical Lead
entry_prerequisites: Strong infrastructure/cloud fundamentals and familiarity with production operations and change management

milestones.rationale: Establish user-visible reliability objectives and observability architecture before resilience decisions.
Connect resilience engineering and incident learning with read-only service evidence and cross-layer diagnosis.
Validate senior reliability, trade-off and incident-leadership judgement.
Integrate SLOs, observability, dependencies, resilience and incident learning into one service reliability review.

paths.dependency_notes: User-visible objectives and observability precede resilience trade-offs; incident evidence and senior judgement precede integrated architecture assurance.
paths.status_rationale: The physical corpus covers SLIs/SLOs, observability, resilience engineering, incident learning, read-only reliability evidence, troubleshooting, assessment, interview judgement and an integrated architecture/SRE capstone.
